The release introduces Workflow Studio for simplified automation and enhanced Platform Analytics for better performance tracking. It also includes new Sales and Order Management and Security Posture Control tools, all underpinned by advanced GenAI integrations.

summary: NXP Semiconductors has announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to enable the deployment of NVIDIA's trained AI models on NXP's edge processing devices through the eIQ machine learning development environment. The new integrated capabilities are expected to be available by the end of 2024, enabling customers to automate tasks, improve human resources, and optimize business processes using AI.

The collaboration will leverage Lenovo's AD1 domain controller, based on the NVIDIA DRIVE Thor platform, and integrate it into WeRide One, a versatile autonomous driving solution. This partnership aims to deliver enhanced autonomous driving products and services globally, focusing on safe and reliable commercial autonomous vehicles.

summary: Infleqtion, a quantum computing startup, has appointed Matthew Kinsella as its new CEO. Kinsella, previously a partner at Maverick Capital and an Infleqtion board member since 2018, replaces Scott Faris. The company focuses on quantum clocks, sensors, and neutral atom-based quantum computing, emphasizing commercial applications and revenue generation in areas like defense and finance.

title: Chip maker SkyWater cancels plans for Indiana plant—at least for now
summary: SkyWater Technology has canceled its plans for a $1.8 billion semiconductor R&D and fabrication facility in West Lafayette, Indiana, which was expected to create 750 jobs. The decision comes as the project was dependent on funding from the CHIPS and Science Act, which SkyWater did not receive. Despite this, Purdue University states SkyWater remains a valued partner for research opportunities, and the Indiana Economic Development Corp. committed incentives, though none were claimed.

summary: Eastman, a global specialty materials company, leveraged its existing data and analytics expertise to begin implementing generative AI. title: US wants Netherlands, Japan to further restrict chipmaking equipment to China
summary: The U.S. is urging the Netherlands and Japan to further restrict China's access to advanced chipmaking equipment, aiming to expand a 2023 agreement designed to prevent China from modernizing its military with such technology. title: Nvidia CEO Huang's multibillion-dollar charitable windfall puts philanthropic strategy in focus
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's stock surge has created a multibillion-dollar philanthropic windfall, primarily held within his private foundation and a donor-advised fund at Charles Schwab Corp. The situation highlights a broader debate in the philanthropic world about the use of donor-advised funds to gain tax breaks while potentially delaying the distribution of funds to working charities.

title: South Korea sets sights on fostering EDA tech to win HBM chip war
